name: Reeva
source:
''Reeva'' is a horror survival game.

You wake up to find yourself in shackles.

Every single day you're submitted to endless torture and pain.

Until one day a certain girl named ''Reeva'' decides to free you.

Your mission is simple: Escape this hellish nightmare with Reeva.

But be careful!

Death looms over your shoulder.

And...

Every wrong choice could spell a ''BAD END''

**

Will you succeed in your escape?

Will you uncover the many secrets surrounding you?

Or

Will you forever rot in your eternal punishment?

[From [url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/reeva]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Reeva》是一款恐怖生存游戏。

你醒来时发现自己被锁链束缚。

你每天都遭受无尽的折磨与痛苦。

直到某一天，一个名叫“Reeva”的女孩决定放你自由。

你的任务很简单：和Reeva一起逃离这场地狱般的噩梦。

但要当心！

死亡正如影随形。

而且……

每一个错误的选择都可能导向“坏结局”。

**

你能成功逃脱吗？

你能揭开围绕着你的重重秘密吗？

还是会在这永恒的惩罚中永远腐朽？

[摘自[url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/reeva]Itch.io[/url]]
